# --- Card 506: AA turret rest row, then a relevancy return on both clients.
host mark
client mark
client2 mark
try host warp actor BP_AI_AATurret_C 2500
try host warp client BP_AI_AATurret_C 2500
try host warp client2 BP_AI_AATurret_C 3000
sleep 3
try host kill actor BP_AI_AATurret_C
try host wait log "card269: host rest row sent guid 0x[0-9a-f]+ seq \S+ to \d+ PC\(s\), BP_AI_AATurret_C" since-mark timeout=20
try client wait log "card269: client rest arrival BP_AI_AATurret_C guid 0x[0-9a-f]+ seq \S+ played over" since-mark timeout=20
try client2 wait log "card269: client rest arrival BP_AI_AATurret_C guid 0x[0-9a-f]+ seq \S+ played over" since-mark timeout=20
host shot c506-turret-dead
client shot c506-turret-dead
client2 shot c506-turret-dead
try host warp client BP_PlayerPresence_C_52 60
try host warp client2 BP_PlayerPresence_C_52 120
sleep 8
client mark
client2 mark
try host warp client BP_AI_AATurret_C 2500
try host warp client2 BP_AI_AATurret_C 3000
try client wait log "card269: client rest arrival BP_AI_AATurret_C guid 0x[0-9a-f]+ seq \S+ played over" since-mark timeout=20
try client2 wait log "card269: client rest arrival BP_AI_AATurret_C guid 0x[0-9a-f]+ seq \S+ played over" since-mark timeout=20
try client look actor BP_AI_AATurret_C 150
try client2 look actor BP_AI_AATurret_C 150
sleep 2
host shot c506-return
client shot c506-return
client2 shot c506-return
host shot c243-end-plant
client shot c243-end-plant
client2 quit
host quit
client quit
